Class AbstractAction

java.lang.Object
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.action.impl.AbstractAction
All Implemented Interfaces:
Action
Direct Known Subclasses:
ActionBarAction, BroadcastAction, BroadcastSoundAction, BroadcastWorldAction, BroadcastWorldSoundAction, ChatAction, CommandAction, ConditionalAction, ConsoleCommandAction, DelayAction, GiveExpAction, GiveMoneyAction, GivePermissionAction, MessageAction, OpenInventoryAction, PlayerCommandAction, PopInventoryAction, RandomAction, SoundAction, TakeExpAction, TakeMoneyAction, TakePermissionAction, TeleportAction, TitleAction
public abstract class AbstractAction extends Object implements Action
Abstract base class for action implementations.

Provides common utilities and service access for all built-in actions. Extending this class is optional — actions only need to implement the Action interface — but it reduces boilerplate for common patterns.

Provided utilities:

  • success() / failure(String) / skipped(String) — result factory methods
  • requirePlayer(ExecutionContext) — extracts the player or returns a failure result
  • services — direct access to the service provider
